executionArgs.additionalInstruction: CRITICAL RULES FOR ALL 12 TESTS: 1) Use UUID (uuid4/crypto.randomUUID) NOT timestamps for ALL unique values (email, username, app name, app URL). Tests run in PARALLEL — timestamps WILL collide. 2) Every test requiring authentication MUST start with FRESH SIGNUP at /auth/signup with a new UUID-based email. NEVER try to login with previously used credentials. 3) TC005 (Update App): The updated URL MUST be a BRAND NEW UUID-based URL different from the creation URL. 4) TC006 (Delete App): Start with FRESH SIGNUP. 5) TC004 (Disable from Details): Start with FRESH SIGNUP at /auth/signup. 6) TC010 (Delete RTF): Start with FRESH SIGNUP with UUID email. 7) TC011 (Update Personal Details): Use SHORT username format like 'user-{uuid8}' (first 8 chars of UUID, max 50 chars). Success = toast notification with success message. 8) TC009 (Change Password): Scroll down to Submit button and click it firmly. Success = toast saying 'Password changed successfully!' and BOTH fields cleared (empty) via formik.resetForm(). 9) TC008 (Add RTF): Select timezone FIRST, then times, then click Submit.
